IN THE HIGH COURT OF JUDICATURE AT BOMBAY
 CRIMINAL APPELLATE JURISDICTION
ANTICIPATORY BAIL APPLICATION NO. 1984 OF 2025 
Abhineet V. Kaushik …Applicant
V/s.
The State of Maharashtra & Anr. ...Respondents.
 …………..
None present for the Applicant. 
Mr. B.V. Holambe Patil, APP for the Respondent/State. 
PSI Mahesh Sawant, Goregaon Police Station is present. 
…………..
CORAM : N.R. BORKAR, J.
DATE      : 18.11.2025. 
 
P .C. :
1. Mentioned out of turn.
2. This is an application for anticipatory bail.
3. The  learned APP for the  respondent/State, on instructions
submits that the applicant has been arrested. In that view o f the
matter,  nothing  survives  in  the  present  application.  The
Application is disposed of as infructuous.
[N.R.BORKAR, J.]  
  
Dinesh S. Sherla 1/1
